name: EspoCRM
tagline: Lightweight open source CRM. PHP + MySQL. Self-hostable, customizable.
shortDescription: A lightweight, flexible open source CRM. PHP + MySQL, custom entities, workflow engine, calendar, telephony integration, mobile app. The mature alternative to SuiteCRM.
longDescription:
## What it is

EspoCRM is a lightweight, flexible open source CRM. PHP-based, MySQL-backed, REST API, custom entities and layouts, workflow engine, calendar, email integration, telephony (Asterisk), and a mobile app.

## Why we recommend it

EspoCRM is more modern than SuiteCRM, easier to customize than Salesforce, and ships with a built-in workflow engine. It's the best lightweight PHP CRM in the OSS world.

## When to use it

- Small to mid-size sales teams that want self-hosting
- Companies with PHP infrastructure
- Custom sales processes that need custom entities
- Replacing HubSpot/Salesforce at a fraction of the cost
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name espocrm -p 80:80 espocrm/espocrm
```

**Manual:** Download from espocrm.com, run the installer, follow the wizard.
pricingDetails: Open source: free. Extensions and premium support from $60/month.
